scope: Targeted nearest-neighbor and source audit, not an exhaustive field review

papers.title: ThinkBLOX: 3D Indoor Scene Generation with Progressive Reasoning
read: Section V experiments including Tables I-III
papers.finding: State-conditioned progressive reasoning followed by structured placement, rationale/action SFT and reasoning-action consistency rewards are already explicit. The candidate contribution cannot be reason-then-act alone.
papers.code_search: No official executable repository established by the bounded search; this is not a claim that none exists

papers.title: Edit-As-Act: Goal-Regressive Planning for Open-Vocabulary 3D Indoor Scene Editing
read: Section 5 principal experiments, ablations and failure discussion
papers.finding: Goal regression, explicit action effects and geometric/semantic validation are direct prior art. The current two-step witness does not establish a new planning algorithm.

coverage.finding: Planner applies geometry and semantic checks. Parser exceptions and no-progress handling need scrutiny before treating this implementation as a certified verifier.
Numeric move feasibility is checked; some missing/symbolic cases are permissive. Unsupported is not independently established as valid.
Geometry execution and symbolic effects have distinct paths, including fallback handling. Runtime correctness was not tested.

official_code.license_note: No license file established from the retrieved tree. Full source was not vendored in this batch.
official_code.boundary: These are bounded source observations, not evidence that the paper's reported experiments were invalid.

local_source.finding: Archived aggregate predicates and ordinary box/access computations are separable from model reasoning. Open-door structural geometry is not fully represented by a single public wall box; access predictions were not fabricated from that approximation.
local_source.execution: No native engine, SDF raycast, access-grid rerun, model inference or training in this batch
